publicReleaseNotes: Uptime 0.5.3 moves to @runeditrun/rer 0.2.106 and makes a company's agent decision feed stricter about privacy. A company that has been stopped or detached can no longer pull decisions: the feed answers with an empty refusal, no company token is accepted, and no person or role the company named can approve. An older approval that was waiting on a company that has since stopped is refused instead of running, and the monitor it would have changed stays as it was. After a re-pairing, one company's decisions no longer appear in another's feed. A new table keeps erased person references retired across a restore of the installation archive. rer 0.2.106 also lets rer deploy --dry-run finish cleanly, tolerates a partial Cloudflare list when retiring the setup token, makes rer signin print the link for a custom domain, and changes the Run page self-host badge from 100% free to On your computer at the next Run site deploy. One additive migration (0088) with no new required settings; update an existing checkout with pnpm install --frozen-lockfile. Back up before upgrading, because 0088 removes cross-company decision-feed entries and cannot be undone; monitors, history, incidents, destinations and private settings are kept. Known issues: a company-signed team roster still names a person you have erased until a later rer release changes how it is kept; a company that has signed an agent policy but never sent company settings is treated as running, so its feed answers with an empty page (no token or decision is shared); rer deploy --dry-run prints its closing block twice; a response body over 64 KiB still fails the check, so monitor a smaller page such as a health endpoint. The product screenshot was taken on 0.4.0, before the console changes of 0.5.0, 0.5.1, 0.5.2 and 0.5.3. Product screenshot: .github/assets/release/uptime-0.4.0-monitor-1440.png
